name: EmbeddingGemma 2 tech report: 740M open multimodal embeddings for text, code, image, audio and video down to 567MB int4
title: EmbeddingGemma 2 tech report: 740M open multimodal embeddings for text, code, image, audio and video down to 567MB int4
summary: Google published the EmbeddingGemma 2 technical report covering architecture, training and ablations for its 740M open multimodal embedding model. The report claims unified text/code/image/audio/video representations that beat larger specialists, with Matryoshka dimensions and int4 quantization down to 567MB for on-device use.
